CharacterDNADesigner.description: Creates the stable base profile before facial structure is generated.

character_name.name: Character name
character_name.tooltip: Stable name used to identify the character.

gender.name: Gender
gender.tooltip: Gender expression included in the base identity prompt.

ancestry.name: Ancestry
ancestry.tooltip: Appearance ancestry included in the base identity prompt.

visual_age.name: Visual age
visual_age.tooltip: The age the character appears to be, from 0 to 120.

CharacterDNAParametricDesigner.description: Overrides one Feature and inherits every other value from the input DNA. Chain nodes to edit multiple features.

feature.name: Feature
feature.tooltip: Select the single structural feature to override.

value.name: Value
value.tooltip: Continuous structural coordinate from -1 to +1; 0 is the neutral baseline.

CharacterDNASeedGenerator.description: Deterministically generates 19 structural dimensions from seed, distinctiveness, and harmony.

seed.name: DNA seed
seed.tooltip: Determines the directions and combination of all 19 Features; identical inputs reproduce the same identity.

distinctiveness.name: Distinctiveness
distinctiveness.tooltip: Controls deviation strength and the number of identity focus features; higher values are more pronounced.

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.tooltip: Controls how strongly conflicting or extreme combinations are softened.

CharacterDNACompositeIdentity.description: Combines the 19 Features into five relational identity descriptions and ranks them by salience.

max_composites.name: Maximum composites
max_composites.tooltip: Keeps the top 1–5 Composite groups without changing the DNA.
